solutions.title: Append, sort, and merge
solutions.strategy: Append the new interval to the list, sort everything, then merge as a normal interval set.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting n + 1 intervals dominates the linear merge pass.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The combined and merged interval lists can both scale with the number of intervals.

solutions.title: Linear insert and merge
solutions.strategy: Copy intervals before the new one, merge overlaps into it, then append the rest.

timeComplexity.explanation: The sorted input intervals are traversed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output list can contain every original interval plus the inserted interval.
